# ik_llama.cpp

> ik_llama.cpp is a distributed inference engine fork supporting multi-stage pipeline parallelism, dynamic per-layer model loading, and hidden-state tensor transfer over TCP and RoCEv2.

## Navigation

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Operational orientation and house rules for autonomous coding agents.
- [docs/BRING-UP.md](docs/BRING-UP.md): Canonical bring-up guide for two-stage loopback and multi-node TCP deployment.
- [docs/RELEASE-INTEGRITY.md](docs/RELEASE-INTEGRITY.md): Release integrity contract, build attestations, and smoke test specifications.
- [README.md](README.md): Repository overview, build prerequisites, and compilation instructions.
- [.agents/skills/ik-fork-bring-up/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/ik-fork-bring-up/SKILL.md): Antigravity and Codex skill registration for bring-up workflows.
- [.claude/skills/ik-fork-bring-up/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/ik-fork-bring-up/SKILL.md): Claude Code skill registration for bring-up workflows.
